prompt: Vertical 9:16 head-and-shoulders portrait of an invented English woman of about 40, her face large, sharp and filling the upper half of the frame, looking straight into the lens. Sun-bleached blonde hair gathered in a loose, slightly undone bun with a few strands falling by her cheek; lightly tanned skin with fine sun lines at the eyes; a calm, serene smile held a fraction too long, perfect white teeth just showing. She wears a loose flowing white linen top with a soft open neckline, a clear quartz crystal pendant on a thin cord at her collarbone, and one hand raised near her chin showing a stack of many wooden and stone beaded bracelets on her wrist. Behind her, softly out of focus, the open bamboo pavilion from the photo: tall curved golden bamboo columns, a woven bamboo ceiling, rows of pale blue floor cushions and dark mats on a polished wooden floor, tropical leaves beyond the railing. Warm late-afternoon sun slanting in from the side, glowing on her hair and the bamboo. Polished, golden, aspirational look, like a luxury wellness advert.
